headline: French Investments Scale Up in Nigeria's Consumer and Agribusiness Sectors
summary: French companies such as Carrefour and Accor are expanding their presence in Nigeria's consumer, hospitality, and agribusiness markets as bilateral trade reaches $4.7 billion.
why: Foreign direct investment inflows into developing consumer markets indicate economic integration and cross-border expansion trends.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Foreign investments increase capital flows into Nigerian consumer and agribusiness sectors.
